name: Tubará (Colombia)
description: Light blue upper half, the lower half divided vertically white and green, charged at the centre with a white oval bearing a black petroglyph and the name TUBARÁ.
history: Municipal flag of Tubará, a municipality in the department of Atlántico, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.
